reviews.title: Good 2s battery.
reviews.body: The seller did a great job, Traxxas, not so much.. not the sellers fault. The Traxxas 2s battery is a good one, purchased for my 3 year old Slash that has taken a beating but keeps on ticking. Other Traxxas electronics I have purchased, including their ID charger seem to have fallen off from the original quality, so I cannot recommend them, but this battery pack is a good one.

features: New iD-Equipped Power Cell batteries deliver unmatched speed, acceleration and power in all Traxxas cars, trucks, and boats
Premium quality, low-resistance cells; flexible, silicone-jacketed 12AWG wire; heavy-duty welded tabs; and Traxxas' High-Current Connectors
Precision assembly with attractive, individually wrapped cells and clear overwrap complete the package
Traxxas capacity ratings reflect the minimum capacity for the pack, not the maximum
3000mAh NiMH 7-C (Flat Pack) 8.4V Battery for Traxxas 1/10 scale vehicles or larger
